_note: EVALUATION ONLY. Stand-in for the orchestrator's intent classification and slot filling (Gemini, needs GCP). Written from the question wording alone, before any run, and not tuned to results: precedent lookups pass the question verbatim as the L2 text; current-rule / decision-history terms are nouns taken from the question; questions that name an order go through the deterministic reference lookup; 'check file X' opens the latest note in file X (the e-Office connector would supply it). The harness therefore measures retrieval GIVEN a correct intent, not intent classification.
